changelog: Search is eventually consistent: new, renamed and edited files reach search_drive_files, search_docs and list_spreadsheets about a minute later (listing a folder is immediate).

tools.description: Search for files and folders within a user's Google Drive, including shared drives

page_size.description: Maximum number of files to return (default 10)

query.description: Search query: plain words, or Drive query syntax (e.g. "name contains 'budget' and trashed = false")

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: search_drive_files

tools.description: Retrieve the content of a Drive file (Docs, Sheets and text files are returned as text)

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: get_drive_file_content

tools.description: Get a temporary download URL for a Drive file, exporting Google files if needed

export_format.description: Export format for Google files (pdf, docx, xlsx, csv, pptx, txt)

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: get_drive_file_download_url

tools.description: Create a new file in Google Drive

fileUrl.description: URL to fetch the file content from

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: create_drive_file

tools.description: Create a new folder in Google Drive

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: create_drive_folder

tools.description: Create a Google Doc by importing text, Markdown or HTML content

content.description: Text, Markdown or HTML to convert into the Doc

file_name.description: Name for the new Google Doc

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: import_to_google_doc

tools.description: List files and folders in a Drive folder

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: list_drive_items

tools.description: Make a copy of a Drive file

parent_folder_id.description: Folder for the copy (default: same folder, or root)

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: copy_drive_file

tools.description: Update a Drive file's metadata, location, trash state, or content

add_parents.description: Comma-separated folder IDs to add as parents (move)

remove_parents.description: Comma-separated folder IDs to remove as parents

trashed.description: Move to or restore from trash

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: update_drive_file

tools.description: Get the shareable link and current sharing settings for a file

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: get_drive_shareable_link

tools.description: Grant, update, or revoke someone's access to a file, or transfer ownership

email_message.description: Message to include in the notification

role.description: Role to grant or update to

send_notification.description: Email the person about the change

share_with.description: Email address of the person (or group) to change access for

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: manage_drive_access

tools.description: Set a file's general (link) access

link_sharing.description: Who can open the file with its link

role.description: Role for people using the link

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: set_drive_file_permissions

tools.description: Lists spreadsheets from Google Drive that the user has access to

max_results.description: Maximum number of spreadsheets to return (default 25)

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: list_spreadsheets

tools.description: Gets information about a specific spreadsheet including its sheets

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: get_spreadsheet_info

tools.description: Reads values from a specific range in a Google Sheet

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: read_sheet_values

clear_values.description: If true, clears the range instead of writing values

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

values.description: 2D array of values to write/update, e.g. [["a", "1"], ["b", "=A1*2"]] (JSON string accepted). Required unless clear_values is true

tools.name: modify_sheet_values

tools.description: Creates a new Google Spreadsheet

sheet_names.description: List of sheet names to create (default: one 'Sheet1')

title.description: The title of the new spreadsheet

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

sheet_name.description: The name of the new sheet

tools.description: Searches for Google Docs by name using Drive API

query.description: Text to search for in document names

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: search_docs

tools.description: Retrieves content of a Google Doc as plain text

document_id.description: The ID of the Google Doc

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: get_doc_content

tools.description: Creates a new Google Doc and optionally inserts initial content

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address (optional in single-user mode)

tools.name: create_doc

document_id.description: The ID of the Google Doc

end_index.description: End index (exclusive) of text to replace; omit to insert at start_index

start_index.description: Start index (1-based, as in the Docs API; 1 is the start of the body)

text.description: Text to insert, or to replace the range with
